purpose: Acquire non-duplicated crypto facts that add causal information beyond a locally derivable transformation of existing data.

active_scope.exchange_scope_rule: Only Binance, OKX and Bybit venue-native datasets may be scheduled. Other venue adapters and existing files are preserved but inactive until the user explicitly changes this list.
active_scope.scheduler_rule: No trade tick, quote/book, L2/L3 or liquidation downloader or stream may start while this scope is active.

identity_contract.venue_rule: The same base asset traded on different venues is not a duplicate because liquidity, price formation, funding, open interest and liquidation state are venue-specific.
identity_contract.duplicate_rule: Two records are duplicates only when they describe the same venue or network, entity, fact family, native time boundary and source revision.
identity_contract.derived_rule: Daily bars, returns, volatility, moving averages and technical indicators are derived locally and never downloaded as separate canonical facts when their raw inputs already exist.
identity_contract.snapshot_rule: A present snapshot is prospective from observed_at and is never projected backward into historical rows.
identity_contract.frequency_rule: Native 5m, hourly, settlement-event and daily facts retain their native frequency; they may be causally joined to 1m bars but are never relabelled as 1m observations.

dimensions.novel_information: 0 duplicates existing facts, 1 useful cross-check, 2 materially new state.
dimensions.causal_availability: 0 timestamp is unsafe, 1 usable prospectively, 2 explicit event or publication time.
dimensions.historical_reconstructability: 0 current-only, 1 bounded history or recurring capture, 2 durable full history.
dimensions.source_authority: 0 opaque derived source, 1 reputable aggregator, 2 venue, network or official source.
dimensions.free_operability: 0 paid or unusable entitlement, 1 free with material quota or license limits, 2 freely automatable at useful scale.

value_score.priority_rule: P0 is score 8-10 and directly useful for training or execution; P1 is score 6-7 or unique prospective microstructure; P2 is score 4-5 and research-only; reject is score 0-3 or locally derivable duplication.

traffic_contract.parallelism: Providers and documented independent endpoint buckets run concurrently. Calls sharing an IP, account, API-key, request-weight or endpoint bucket share one process-safe limiter.
capacity_order: finish gaps in canonical primary facts
maintain short-retention append-only facts before they expire
refresh current snapshots at no faster than upstream freshness
traffic_contract.fallback_rule: A fallback runs only for missing canonical keys, an unavailable primary, or an explicit low-volume quality sample; it never creates a second canonical copy.
traffic_contract.quota_rule: Key presence does not imply entitlement. Runtime headers or key-info endpoints are authoritative for the active request and credit limits.

datasets.title: 交易所商品定義、上架下架與合約規格
datasets.mechanism: Stable instrument identity is required to prevent symbol collisions, survivorship bias and incorrect contract joins.
datasets.storage_contract: venue-native catalogs with immutable observed_at snapshots; Binance archive lifecycle is inferred from first/last official archive coverage and explicitly labelled as such

datasets.title: 交易所原生現貨 1 分鐘成交 K 線
datasets.mechanism: Spot price discovery and cash-market volume are distinct from perpetual swaps and from cross-venue aggregate prices.
fallbacks: CoinGecko aggregate market snapshot for missing asset-level reference only
datasets.storage_contract: one canonical row per completed venue bar; Binance official SHA-256 verified archives use daily-over-monthly precedence and normalize 2025+ spot microseconds to milliseconds; daily derived locally

datasets.title: 交易所原生永續合約 1 分鐘成交 K 線
datasets.mechanism: Perpetual price, volume and taker activity are the executable state for derivatives strategies.
datasets.storage_contract: completed 1m bars; daily derived locally

datasets.title: 交割合約與次季合約 1 分鐘成交 K 線
datasets.mechanism: Calendar basis and roll expectations cannot be reconstructed from perpetual swaps alone.
datasets.storage_contract: preserve every expired contract and explicit delivery timestamp; Binance official SHA-256 verified archives are partitioned by venue symbol and month

datasets.title: 標記價格、指數價格與溢價／基差
datasets.mechanism: Liquidation reference, fair-value anchor and leverage crowding are not recoverable from last trade price.
datasets.storage_contract: native mark, index and premium remain separate columns

datasets.title: 資金費率預測、結算值與結算時程
datasets.mechanism: Funding transfers reveal leverage demand and are a realized cash flow for perpetual positions.
fallbacks: DefiLlama perps only for venues without native historical endpoints
datasets.storage_contract: predicted and realized funding are different facts; forward-fill only with age

datasets.title: 未平倉量與名目價值
datasets.mechanism: Open interest separates new leverage formation from simple turnover and price movement.
fallbacks: CoinGlass only when the configured plan is entitled and only for missing venues
datasets.storage_contract: short-retention sources are captured append-only before expiry

datasets.title: 多空帳戶／部位比與主動買賣流
datasets.mechanism: Position crowding and aggressive flow can move independently from total volume.
datasets.storage_contract: account ratio, position ratio and taker volume are never merged as one metric

datasets.title: 選擇權鏈、成交量、OI、Greeks、IV 與波動率指數
datasets.mechanism: The volatility surface and skew encode forward distribution and tail-risk prices unavailable from spot candles.
datasets.deferred_reason: 目前只回補 1 分 K；交易所選擇權鏈、Greeks、IV 快照與逐筆交易待使用者明確重新啟用。
datasets.storage_contract: prospective snapshots plus venue trade history; compute surfaces locally

datasets.title: 跨市場資產身分、合約地址、平台與生命週期
datasets.mechanism: A canonical asset map is needed to join venue symbols, chains and token contracts without ticker ambiguity.
fallbacks: CoinMarketCap cryptocurrency map
datasets.storage_contract: CoinGecko is canonical; CoinMarketCap is queried only for unresolved IDs or QA

datasets.title: 跨市場市值、流通量、總供給與全市場占比
datasets.mechanism: Supply and market-cap state identify dilution and market breadth not present in venue price-volume data.
fallbacks: CoinMarketCap validation sample only
datasets.storage_contract: one canonical aggregate source; no Yahoo or CMC full duplicate archive

datasets.title: 穩定幣供給、鏈別分布與脫鉤
datasets.mechanism: Stablecoin issuance and redemption proxy crypto-native liquidity, while peg stress is direct market risk.
fallbacks: CoinMetrics Community for network-specific supply where available
datasets.storage_contract: historical charts and current chain distribution retain publication vintage

datasets.title: 鏈與協議 TVL
datasets.mechanism: Capital committed to chains and protocols measures adoption and withdrawal stress beyond token price.
datasets.storage_contract: avoid double-counted TVL variants and preserve methodology identifiers

datasets.title: DEX、鏈上衍生品與選擇權成交量
datasets.mechanism: On-chain venue activity captures liquidity migration not visible in centralized exchange feeds.
fallbacks: Dune saved queries for protocols absent from DefiLlama
datasets.storage_contract: daily volume and notional volume remain distinct

datasets.title: 協議費用、收入與持幣者收入
datasets.mechanism: Fees and revenue measure economic use and cash-flow capture rather than only capital locked.
fallbacks: Dune saved queries for missing protocols
datasets.storage_contract: fees, protocol revenue, supply-side revenue and holder revenue are separate facts

datasets.title: 鏈上地址、交易、費用、供給、發行、燃燒與安全性指標
datasets.mechanism: Network utilization, monetary issuance and security budget are fundamental state variables.
fallbacks: chain-native explorer or public RPC for missing community metrics
datasets.storage_contract: catalog-declared community metrics only; revisions retain retrieval vintage

datasets.title: Bitcoin mempool、費率、難度與算力
datasets.mechanism: Immediate block-space demand and mining security change faster than daily network metrics.
fallbacks: Coin Metrics Community daily network metrics
datasets.storage_contract: compact mempool state only; never download the full mempool transaction list

datasets.title: Ethereum 即時 gas 建議與 base fee
datasets.mechanism: Block-space price measures current congestion; daily supply and total fees remain owned by the non-duplicated Coin Metrics network fact.
fallbacks: Etherscan V2 after its configured key becomes operational
Coin Metrics FeeTotNtv is daily context, not a realtime substitute
datasets.storage_contract: prospective snapshots only; retain Blockscout deprecation warning and never substitute a current gas quote for historical blocks

datasets.title: DeFi 供給利率、借款利率、TVL 與風險分類
datasets.mechanism: On-chain cost of capital and leverage demand are distinct from token returns.
canonical_owners: DefiLlama legacy free yields endpoint while accessible
fallbacks: Dune saved protocol queries
datasets.storage_contract: rate type, incentives and utilization are separate; endpoint entitlement is rechecked

datasets.title: 逐筆成交與聚合成交
datasets.mechanism: Trade direction, clustering and realized impact are lost in one-minute aggregation.
datasets.deferred_reason: 目前只回補 1 分 K；逐筆成交待使用者明確重新啟用。
datasets.storage_contract: raw immutable partitions; aggregate trades and individual trades remain labelled

datasets.title: 最佳買賣價與數量
datasets.mechanism: Executable spread and displayed liquidity determine fill price and transaction cost.
datasets.deferred_reason: 目前只回補 1 分 K；最佳買賣報價待使用者明確重新啟用。
datasets.storage_contract: prospective capture with sequence-gap receipts

datasets.title: L2 深度快照與增量
datasets.mechanism: Depth shape, imbalance and impact capacity cannot be reconstructed from trades or top of book.
datasets.deferred_reason: 目前只回補 1 分 K；L2/L3 深度待使用者明確重新啟用。
datasets.storage_contract: snapshot plus contiguous deltas; gaps invalidate the reconstructed book

datasets.title: 強平事件與跨市場強平總量
datasets.mechanism: Forced deleveraging is an exogenous order-flow impulse not identifiable from ordinary trades alone.
fallbacks: CoinGlass only for venues without native coverage and only with entitlement
datasets.deferred_reason: 目前只回補 1 分 K；強平事件待使用者明確重新啟用。
datasets.storage_contract: CoinGlass currently has no usable plan entitlement; do not poll paid endpoints

datasets.title: 跨鏈橋流量與淨流入
datasets.mechanism: Capital migration between chains can lead local liquidity and activity changes.
fallbacks: DefiLlama only when a free bridge endpoint is explicitly available
datasets.storage_contract: query SQL hash and execution time are part of lineage

datasets.title: 交易所鏈上儲備、存提款與淨流量
datasets.mechanism: Deposits can proxy potential sell supply while withdrawals can proxy custody demand.
fallbacks: venue proof-of-reserves snapshots for balance only
datasets.storage_contract: address-label version is mandatory; unlabeled flow is not called exchange flow

datasets.title: 代幣解鎖、發行、燃燒與質押排程
datasets.mechanism: Known supply shocks change expected dilution and tradable float.
canonical_owners: chain-native contracts and project schedules via curated Dune queries
fallbacks: Coin Metrics Community realized supply metrics
datasets.storage_contract: planned unlocks and realized on-chain issuance are separate facts

datasets.title: 現貨 ETF 流量、AUM、持倉與折溢價
datasets.mechanism: ETF creations and redemptions are a regulated-market demand channel distinct from crypto venues.
canonical_owners: issuer and SEC filings where machine-readable
fallbacks: Dune or CoinGlass only with verified entitlement and source lineage
datasets.storage_contract: published_at is mandatory; revised issuer files retain versions

datasets.title: 可重現 Dune 鏈上查詢結果
datasets.mechanism: SQL-defined facts can cover protocol-specific activity that standardized providers omit.
datasets.storage_contract: the key alone is insufficient; query IDs and expected primary keys are required

datasets.title: 駭客事件、漏洞、停鏈與重大服務事故
datasets.mechanism: Security incidents directly alter solvency, confidence and protocol availability.
canonical_owners: official project disclosures and chain status feeds
fallbacks: GDELT event discovery followed by source verification
datasets.storage_contract: discovery articles are not truth until linked to a primary disclosure

datasets.title: 利率、美元、流動性、CFTC 部位與監管事件
datasets.mechanism: Crypto risk appetite and institutional positioning respond to monetary and regulatory state.
fallbacks: GDELT for discovery only
datasets.storage_contract: revision vintage and release time are mandatory

datasets.title: 協議開發活動與版本發布
datasets.mechanism: Sustained development may signal maintenance and product progress but is noisy and easy to game.
canonical_owners: GitHub public API and project repositories
fallbacks: CoinGecko repository mapping
datasets.storage_contract: forks, bots and repository migrations require explicit normalization

datasets.title: 專案公告、治理提案與新聞事件
datasets.mechanism: Discrete information changes expectations but entity resolution and publication latency dominate quality.
canonical_owners: project governance APIs and official feeds
fallbacks: GDELT for discovery and broad coverage
datasets.storage_contract: publication time and corrections are retained; text embeddings are derived locally

datasets.title: 恐懼貪婪與低頻市場情緒
datasets.mechanism: Aggregated sentiment may capture positioning psychology but often repackages price momentum.
datasets.storage_contract: research-only until incremental value beyond price is demonstrated

datasets.title: 受監管加密期貨交易者部位
datasets.mechanism: Trader-category positioning can reveal leverage and hedging pressure that price bars alone do not identify.
fallbacks: CFTC historical compressed reports
datasets.storage_contract: event history is retained with assumed and strict availability clocks; training is quarantined until historical release dates are audited

datasets.title: 公開百科條目關注度
datasets.mechanism: Article-reading demand is a public attention proxy distinct from exchange order flow, but redirects and revisions can change interpretation.
datasets.storage_contract: historical observations are retained with local first-observed timestamps and are not backprojected into the causal training ABI

rejected_or_fallback_only.reason: Seven-day aggregate proxy history duplicates primary price facts, lacks venue identity and consumes many symbol requests.
Moving averages, RSI, MACD, volatility and returns are deterministic local transforms of canonical raw facts.
CoinMarketCap full market snapshots overlap the CoinGecko canonical aggregate dataset.
Current key has no usable plan entitlement and exchange-native OI/funding is more authoritative.
rejected_or_fallback_only.action: do_not_poll_until_entitled; use only for unique missing aggregate facts

rejected_or_fallback_only.reason: Present order books, OI, gas quotes or positioning cannot reconstruct past state.
